Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

A small, inscrutable bloodline descended from @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.phgt6OMwTAoAaKfR]{Lasombra} mingled with fey blood, the Kiasyd are few in number and deeply strange even by Kindred standards. Their otherworldly nature grants them unusual insight and arcane talents not shared by other Sabbat.

Disciplines: Dominate, Mytherceria, Obtenebration

Advantage: Kiasyd gain two Lore Abilities of their choice at no extra cost during character creation.

Disadvantage: Cold iron causes Kiasyd genuine pain and discomfort, imposing a one-Trait penalty on Self-Control/Instinct tests in the presence of an iron weapon; any damage inflicted by iron is considered aggravated.

Organization: Kiasyd are rare and solitary, rarely forming large groups even within the Sabbat, and their motives remain largely opaque to other Cainites.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{the Sabbat} - the antitribu designation itself marks this bloodline's members as having sided with the Sabbat rather than the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}.
